technology_name: LOW-COST CUTTER FOR CUTTING HOT BILLETS AND HOT PIPES WHILE IN MOTION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Industrial Automation Hardware / Heavy Machinery Modification
problem_solved: Conventional industrial flying cut-off saws require heavy hydraulic rails, introduce massive positioning drift, and cause severe edge burring when handling hot structural metal profiles under motion.
description: A robust, low-cost mechanical cutter assembly engineered with a coaxially mounted gear unit, a dual-rail horizontal slide carrier, and a rock-and-pinion transmission driven by two customized spokes to cut high-temperature material extrusions seamlessly.
applications: Continuous metal casting steel mills, automated hot pipe extrusion lines, manufacturing plant upgrade retrofits, and high-precision structural steel fabrication shops.
